fault_models.SAF: Stuck-at fault: a cell always reads 0 or 1.
fault_models.TF: Transition fault: a cell cannot make a 0->1 or 1->0 transition.
fault_models.CF: Coupling fault: writing or reading one cell disturbs a neighbouring cell.
fault_models.SOF: Stuck-open fault: the cell cannot be accessed, reads return stale data.
fault_models.DRF: Data retention fault: the cell loses its value after a pause.
fault_models.BL_OPEN: Bitline open: cells beyond the break cannot be read or written on that column.
fault_models.BL_BRIDGE: Bitline bridge: a bitline is shorted to its complement, a neighbour or a supply; the column misreads.
fault_models.WL_OPEN: Wordline open: cells beyond the break are never selected on that row.
fault_models.WL_BRIDGE: Wordline bridge: a wordline is shorted; the row is mis-selected or always selected.
fault_models.PWR_SHORT: Supply short: vdd shorted to gnd; the die draws excess current.
fault_models.AF: Address decoder fault: wrong, multiple or no rows selected for an address.
fault_models.SA_FAULT: Sense amplifier fault: the column output is wrong or slow.
fault_models.WD_FAULT: Write driver fault: the column cannot be written correctly.
fault_models.PRE_FAULT: Precharge fault: bitlines are not precharged; reads on the column fail.
fault_models.CTRL_FAULT: Control logic fault: clocks or enables are wrong; the macro misbehaves globally.
fault_models.UNKNOWN: Effect cannot be determined from the image.

tests.MATS+: Short March test (w0; up r0,w1; down r1,w0); catches stuck-at and address faults.
tests.March C-: 10N March test; catches stuck-at, transition, address and most coupling faults.
tests.March SS: 22N March test; adds static coupling and read-disturb coverage.
tests.Checkerboard: Alternating 0/1 pattern; exposes bridges between neighbouring cells and lines.
tests.Data retention test: Write, pause (e.g. 100 ms), read; exposes weak pull-ups and opens on supply lines.
tests.Address decoder test: March C- with address-complement ordering; targets decoder faults.
tests.IDDQ test: Measure quiescent supply current; exposes supply shorts and bridges.
tests.Functional test: Full read/write functional test of the macro at speed.
tests.Visual re-inspection: Re-image the area at higher magnification before deciding.

entries.template: Bridge between bitline and its complement on column {cols} makes reads on that column fail. Run March C- on column {cols} to confirm, then replace it with a spare column.
entries.source: Bitline-pair bridges behave as column-wide read faults (van de Goor, Testing Semiconductor Memories, ch. on bridging faults).

entries.template: Bridge between bitlines of neighbouring columns {cols} couples them. Run a checkerboard and March SS on columns {cols}; repair both columns with spares if confirmed.
entries.source: Inter-column bridges cause coupling faults detected by checkerboard patterns.

entries.template: Bridge on wordline of row {rows} disturbs row selection. Run March C- with address-complement order on row {rows}; replace the row with a spare row.
entries.source: Wordline shorts appear as row-wide stuck-at or address faults.

entries.template: Material shorts vdd to gnd. Confirm with an IDDQ current measurement; a supply short cannot be repaired, scrap the die.
entries.source: Supply shorts raise quiescent current and are not repairable with redundancy.

entries.template: Bridge on the storage node of cell row {rows}, column {cols} pins the cell to one value. Run March C- to confirm the stuck-at fault and repair with a spare row or column.
entries.source: Storage-node shorts produce stuck-at faults.

entries.template: Extra material inside the bitcell array near rows {rows}, columns {cols} can couple cells. Run March SS and a checkerboard on the area; repair affected lines with spares.
entries.source: Generic intra-array bridges are covered by March SS.

entries.template: Break in the bitline of column {cols} disconnects cells beyond it. Run March C- on column {cols}; replace the column with a spare column.
entries.source: Bitline opens give stuck-open behaviour for cells past the break.

entries.template: Break in the wordline of row {rows} leaves cells past the break unselected. Run March C- on row {rows}; replace the row with a spare row.
entries.source: Wordline opens behave like address faults for the cut-off cells.

entries.template: Break in a supply line near row {rows} starves cells of power, so they may lose data. Run a data retention test and March C- on row {rows}; repair with a spare row.
entries.source: Supply opens cause weak cells and retention failures.

entries.template: Break inside the bitcell at row {rows}, column {cols} can block transitions. Run March C- to confirm and repair with a spare row or column.
entries.source: Intra-cell opens give transition or stuck-open faults.

entries.template: Missing contact or via in the cell at row {rows}, column {cols} breaks a connection, so the cell may not switch or be read. Run March C- on that cell; repair with a spare row or column.
entries.source: Missing contacts behave as resistive or full opens.

entries.template: Particle over rows {rows}, columns {cols} may short or open several cells. Run March SS and a checkerboard on the area; repair affected lines with spares.
entries.source: Spot defects (particles) cause multi-cell coupling and stuck-at faults.

entries.template: Defect in the row decoder can select wrong or multiple rows. Confirm with an address-decoder March test; decoder faults are not repairable with spare rows, scrap the die.
entries.source: Decoder faults map to address faults (AF).

entries.template: Defect in a sense amplifier corrupts reads on its column. Confirm with March C- reads; this macro has no spare sense amp, scrap the die.
entries.source: Sense-amp faults appear as column read failures.

entries.template: Defect in a write driver prevents correct writes on its column. Confirm with March C- write-read sequences; not repairable here, scrap the die.
entries.source: Write-driver faults appear as transition faults on a column.

entries.template: Defect in the bitline precharge stops bitlines resetting before a read. Confirm with March C-; not repairable here, scrap the die.
entries.source: Precharge faults cause read failures on affected columns.

entries.template: Defect in the control logic affects the whole macro. Run a full functional test to confirm; scrap the die.
entries.source: Control-path defects are global failures.

entries.template: Defect is in the dummy or replica cells at the array edge and does not affect stored data. No repair needed; note it in the log.
entries.source: Dummy cells are not addressed.

entries.template: Defect is outside the circuit area and has no electrical effect. No action needed.
entries.source: Outside active circuitry.

entries.template: Defect is on routing between blocks, so the affected signal is unknown. Re-inspect at higher magnification and run a functional test before deciding.
entries.source: Routing nets are not extracted in this build.

entries.template: Extra material bridges features inside a repeating memory array, which can short neighbouring cells or lines. Without the layout the nets are unknown; re-inspect and check against the die's design before deciding.
entries.source: Bridges in arrays usually cause coupling or stuck-at faults; cell-to-cell comparison finds them without a design file.

entries.template: A break in a repeating array line can disconnect cells beyond it. Without the layout the line can't be identified; re-inspect and check against the die's design before deciding.
entries.source: Opens in array lines behave as stuck-open faults for the cut-off cells.

entries.template: A particle on the array may short or open several cells. Without the layout its exact cells are unknown; re-inspect and check against the die's design before deciding.
entries.source: Spot defects cause multi-cell coupling and stuck-at faults.

entries.template: A contact or via appears to be missing in a repeating cell, which can leave that cell unreadable. Without the layout it can't be pinned to a bitcell; re-inspect and check against the die's design.
entries.source: Missing contacts behave as resistive or full opens.

entries.template: Unrecognised anomaly that does not match the golden layout. Re-inspect it before making a decision.
entries.source: Anomaly path.

entries.template: The detection or its position on the layout is uncertain. Re-image the area and inspect again before deciding.
entries.source: Review path for low-confidence cases.
